## Unused variable, import, function or class Unused import bodyDigest. ---

To fix this without changing behavior, remove only the unused named import bodyDigest from the destructured import in scripts/official-candidate-write.mjs.

Best single change:

  • In the top import block (lines 2–4 in the snippet), delete bodyDigest from the named import list.
  • Keep all other imports unchanged.
  • No new methods, definitions, or dependencies are needed.
